caseName: Insurance Co. of North America v. Steamship Westminster
caseNameFull: Insurance Company of North America v. Steamship Westminster, etc.

opinions.text: May 31, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied. Mr. Horace L. Cheyney and Mr. Jno. F. Lewis for petitioner. Mr. J. Parker Kirlin for respondent.
